title: Diagnostic Analysis for Large Language Model Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning structures (e.g., chains and graphs) are increasingly used for probabilistic inference, factuality verification, and uncertainty estimation, but their structural reliability is rarely evaluated directly. We test whether this reliability holds through a proposed two-stage diagnostic evaluation in open-ended multi-hop QA. Stage 1 tests different capabilities required to construct reasoning graphs, showing that graph reliability varies with topology, prompt design, and model family. Stage 2 uses uncertainty estimation as a downstream test case. Generated-edge experiments show that graph-based computation is sensitive to upstream graph errors, with performance dropping relative to the gold-graph setting. Gold-graph experiments further show that graph structure provides little benefit when used only as prompt context, but improves the separation of correct from incorrect answers by confidence score and enables node-level diagnostics

translated_title: 大语言模型推理的诊断分析
translated_abstract: 推理结构（如链和图）越来越多地被用于概率推断、事实性验证和不确定性估计，但其结构可靠性很少被直接评估。我们通过在开放式多跳问答中提出的两阶段诊断评估来检验这种可靠性是否成立。第一阶段测试构建推理图所需的不同能力，结果表明图的可靠性随拓扑结构、提示设计和模型家族而变化。第二阶段将不确定性估计作为下游测试用例。生成边实验表明，基于图的计算对上游图错误敏感，相对于金标准图设置其性能有所下降。金标准图实验进一步表明，图结构仅作为提示上下文使用时收益甚微，但它能改善通过置信度分数对正确与错误答案的区分能力，并支持节点级诊断。
tldr: 本文提出两阶段诊断评估方法，系统检验大语言模型推理图的结构可靠性，发现图可靠性受拓扑、提示设计和模型家族影响，且图结构仅在基于置信度分数区分正确答案和支持节点级诊断方面有价值，仅作为提示上下文时收益有限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage diagnostic evaluation to systematically test the structural reliability of LLM reasoning graphs, finding that reliability varies with topology, prompt design, and model family, and that graph structure mainly improves confidence-based separation of correct from incorrect answers and enables node-level diagnostics, while offering little benefit when used merely as prompt context.
